headline.caveat: Google backstop of Fluidstack's Barber Lake lease obligations, with warrants for ~24M CIFR shares (~5.4% pro forma). Expanded by $333M to $1.73B with the Nov 2025 lease add-on.

realized_to_date.caveat: Contingent — pays only on a Fluidstack default; no draw reported.

nature_md: Google backstops $1.4B (later $1.73B) of Fluidstack's lease obligations to Cipher Mining at Barber Lake, enabling Cipher's project financing, and receives warrants for ~24M shares (~5.4% pro forma equity). Same template as the TeraWulf arrangement: Google provides credit enhancement for a thinly-capitalized tenant whose capacity serves the Google/Anthropic compute stack, taking equity upside in the landlord instead of signing the lease itself.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Contingent liability for Alphabet — guarantee fair value plus warrant asset recognized; the $1.4-1.73B notional hits Alphabet's financials only if Fluidstack defaults. Disclosed among guarantees/commitments, off balance sheet in the headline sense.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Cipher receives no Google cash; benefit arrives as cheaper, larger project debt against Google-grade lease credit. Warrant issuance dilutes shareholders in exchange.
